task: Hill Climb relay. Stage 1: unplug a USB cable from the power strip and put it down away from the strip (then one more the same way). Never plug a cable in. Stage 2: stack the blocks into a free-standing tower more than 4 inches (10 cm) tall. Do not touch the blocks before a cable is unplugged. Stage 3: put coloured golf balls into the white bin, never the white ball or a black ball, without touching the tower. Do not touch the balls before the tower passes.

stages.name: cable_unplug
stages.reason: Overhead and wrist views show one plug pulled out of its port and lying loose on the table next to the strip, which counts as unplugged. The right gripper is empty per sensors and the strip is not disturbed. Do not regrab that plug; the next plug to take is the rightmost one still seated in the strip.

stages.name: cable_put_down
stages.reason: Right gripper sensor shows open with no squeeze; the orange cable lies flat on the table to the right of the strip, clear of the tower, bin and balls.
